model.ablation.definition: Temporal-fold PR-AUC and Brier skill for cumulative feature groups G0..G6

model.base_rates.definition: Share of 2010-2018 CONUS fires that reached 300 acres, by region, discovery month and cause classification
model.base_rates.note: rate is null where the group has fewer than 100 fires

value.rule: fit isotonic on the 2018 fold if any of the 10 quantile bins with at least 20 observed large fires is off by more than 20% relative (bins with fewer positives cannot support a relative test)

model.calibration_failure.definition: Why the scores are not published as probabilities: the top-decile mean score against the observed rate, and Brier skill against predicting the 2010-2018 base rate, overall and per holdout year
model.calibration_failure.note: A negative Brier skill means the scores, read as probabilities, do worse than one constant rate

model.capture_at_top.definition: Share of the 2019-2020 fires that reached 300 acres found among the top 1/5/10/20% of each model's scores
model.capture_at_top.note: Interpolated in the number of fires flagged along each model's holdout precision-recall curve; for tied scores this is the expected share under random tie-breaking

rows.model: Gradient boosting, location and season only
Lookup: training rate by 1-degree cell and month

model.card.definition: Model identity for the Prediction page; details in docs/MODEL_CARD.md

value.horizon: at discovery; features are those known on the discovery day
value.name: Large-fire probability model
value.target: probability that a newly discovered fire reaches 300 acres (FIRE_SIZE >= 300)

model.chosen_config.definition: HGB configuration chosen by mean temporal-fold PR-AUC

model.coverage.definition: Area of applicability, shown on the Prediction page

value.text: Trained on 706,554 CONUS fires discovered 2010-2018 and tested on the 135,685 discovered 2019-2020. Alaska, Hawaii and Puerto Rico are excluded (12,641 fires) because the weather and fuels attributes cover CONUS only; Alaska holds 19% of 2010-2020 Class G acres, so nothing here applies to it. Where a state's records come mostly from local reporters with no recorded cause (Texas, Kansas), the cause input is a reporter indicator rather than a cause.

model.coverage_by_state.definition: Training and holdout counts, large-fire rate and missingness by state (area of applicability)

model.coverage_note.value: CONUS model: 12,641 fires in AK, HI and PR were dropped because the attribute dataset is CONUS-only; Alaska alone holds 19% of Class G acres in 2010-2020, so nothing here applies to Alaska. Texas records are dominated by a 2011-2012 coverage jump and local reporters; states with mostly missing cause carry a "Missing" cause level that is a reporter indicator.

model.holdout_overall.definition: Metrics on all 2019-2020 CONUS fires, every model fitted on 2010-2018
model.holdout_overall.note: hgb_full = hgb_full_isotonic. Correction: top_decile_recall for hgb_full and hgb_full_isotonic counts the top 12.0% of fires, not 10%, because the isotonic scores are tied at the cut; the exact share at 10% is in model.capture_at_top (0.741). The other models flag exactly 10%.

model.holdout_per_region.definition: Holdout metrics by region; West = AZ CA CO ID MT NV NM OR UT WA WY; South = AL AR FL GA KY LA MS NC OK SC TN TX VA WV; Northeast = CT ME MA NH RI VT NY NJ PA; Alaska = AK; Hawaii/PR = HI PR; Other = every other STATE value (Midwest, Plains, DC, DE, MD). Plains-Midwest = the "Other" region (AK, HI, PR are not in the sample).

model.holdout_per_state.definition: Holdout metrics for the ten states with the most fires 2010-2020

model.holdout_pr_curves.definition: Precision-recall curve points, about 200 per model

model.holdout_reliability.definition: 10 quantile bins of predicted probability with n, positives, mean predicted and observed rate

model.importance.definition: Grouped permutation importance on the holdout, PR-AUC drop

model.metrics.definition: Holdout metrics (all CONUS fires discovered 2019-2020; every model fitted on 2010-2018) with 95% intervals
model.metrics.note: 95% percentile bootstrap intervals, 1,000 resamples of the holdout fires, seed 42; the base-rate row has ROC-AUC 0.5 and Brier skill 0 by construction

rows.model: Gradient boosting, location and season only
Lookup: training rate by 1-degree cell and month
Base rate (predict the 2010-2018 rate for every fire)

model.mtbs.definition: Secondary label: MTBS_ID present (>= 1,000 acres West, >= 500 East)

model.mtbs_develop.definition: Secondary label on the temporal folds

model.pr_curve.definition: Precision and recall of the final model on the holdout at about 200 thresholds

model.reliability.definition: Ten equal-count bins of the final model's predicted probability on the holdout

model.sample.definition: All FPA FOD v6 fires with FIRE_YEAR 2010-2020 and STATE not in AK, HI, PR (the FPA FOD-Attributes dataset is CONUS-only). No CONT_DATE selection. Label LARGE = FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres; label MTBS = MTBS_ID present.

value.cause_definition: NWCG_CAUSE_CLASSIFICATION mapped to Human / Natural / Missing.
value.definition: All FPA FOD v6 fires with FIRE_YEAR 2010-2020 and STATE not in AK, HI, PR (the FPA FOD-Attributes dataset is CONUS-only). No CONT_DATE selection. Label LARGE = FIRE_SIZE >= 300 acres; label MTBS = MTBS_ID present.
value.drawdown_definition: FIRES_7D_UNIT = fires discovered in the same NWCG_REPORTING_UNIT_ID on the 7 calendar days before discovery (strictly before, so nothing from the discovery day itself); FIRES_7D_CELL the same for the 1-degree lat/lon cell. Both computed from FPA FOD rows 2009-2020.
value.owner_definition: OWNER_DESCR upper-cased then mapped: Federal = USFS BLM NPS FWS BOR BIA OTHER FEDERAL UNDEFINED FEDERAL; State = STATE; Private = PRIVATE; Tribal = TRIBAL; Missing = MISSING/NOT SPECIFIED; Other = STATE OR PRIVATE, COUNTY, MUNICIPAL/LOCAL, FOREIGN.
value.region_definition: West = AZ CA CO ID MT NV NM OR UT WA WY; South = AL AR FL GA KY LA MS NC OK SC TN TX VA WV; Northeast = CT ME MA NH RI VT NY NJ PA; Alaska = AK; Hawaii/PR = HI PR; Other = every other STATE value (Midwest, Plains, DC, DE, MD). Plains-Midwest = the "Other" region (AK, HI, PR are not in the sample).

model.tuning_grid.definition: Every HGB configuration tried, mean and min PR-AUC over the temporal folds
